data.name: Reehan
data.gender_notes: Reehan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Reehan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Rahana' which means to protect or preserve. It is a name that evokes feelings of contentment and joy. It is also associated with the peaceful and calming elements of nature, particularly the sun, rain, and moon. The name Reehan carries the meaning “content, joy, peaceful” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Urdu. Parents who choose Reehan usually hope their child will grow to embody content, joy, peaceful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Reehan holds deep spiritual significance in Hinduism. It is believed that the name invokes the blessings of the gods and goddesses, particularly those associated with the sun, rain, and moon. It is also believed to bring peace and tranquility to one's life.
data.etymology: Reehan belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “content, joy, peaceful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Reehan total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
